title: Three hours
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when the blood-colored patterns intertwined with the golden light in his pupils, Chen Ji felt a long-dormant chain within him shattering—and high above in the Nine Heavens, some consciousness beyond human comprehension turned its gaze for the first time upon this ant who dared to shake the chessboard.

text.content: Elder Zhou's laughter echoed on the stone steps of the Council Hall, mournful like a night owl. Chen Ji stood before the hall, watching that hunchbacked figure being escorted toward the Law Enforcement Hall, his fingers tightening within his sleeves. 'The Heavenly Eye's chess game?' He repeated these words quietly, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. 'Elder Zhou, do you think speaking these words will shake me?' He turned around, morning light falling upon that seemingly timid face, yet unable to illuminate the deep-seated ice hidden in his eyes.

Three hours. That death deadline hanging like a sword over his head had finally passed. Yet Chen Ji felt no relief—the Tianji Record fragment trembled subtly in his consciousness, the once-bright golden light now dim as a dying candle. Heavenly Fate, only the final thread remained. He could clearly sense that number continuing to slip away at an invisible speed, like the last grain of sand in an hourglass, poised to reach zero at any moment.

dialogue.content: 'Brother.' A cold and clear voice came from behind. Chen Ji spun around to find Chen Nian standing within the shadows of the corridor pillar. She wore a pure white dress today, her black hair cascading like a waterfall, yet those eyes seemed deeper than in memory, as if concealing an entire sea of stars. 'The three-hour deadline has passed, but your Heavenly Fate...' She stepped closer, her voice trembling slightly, 'only three points remain.'

text.content: Three. Chen Ji silently repeated this number in his heart, yet a self-mocking curve tugged at his lips. An ordinary person feeling this should have been seized with panic long ago, but what surfaced in his heart was the words once spoken by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul—'When the Tianji Record acknowledges a master, the day Heavenly Fate reaches zero is when the host's soul scatters.' He raised his head to look at Chen Nian, his gaze terrifyingly calm: 'Nian'er, you specifically came to find me, surely it wasn't just to tell me this news?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian fell silent for a moment, then suddenly raised her hand to press against her heart. Her fingertips radiated a faint blood-colored glow, echoing distantly with the golden light of the Tianji Record remaining in Chen Ji's body. 'The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key... can briefly prolong life.' Her voice was soft, yet each word was clear. 'But each use accelerates the arrival of that prophecy.' She raised her head, meeting Chen Ji's eyes directly, 'Brother, you carry the same bloodline as me—the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. We are two keys to the same lock.'

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Chen Ji's heart jolted. This term was not unfamiliar to him—it had appeared like a ghost several times in Mo Xiansheng's occasional fragments and in the flickering visions within the Tianji Record fragment. 'Does the lock seal the Heavenly Eye's surveillance, or...' He abruptly raised his head, pupils narrowing, 'or is it the death prophecy itself?' Chen Nian's fingers slightly tightened, the blood-colored light intensifying: 'Both. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key can disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight, but the cost is—each disruption is telling the Heavenly Eye, we are here.'

dialogue.content: 'Heavenly Eye...' Chen Ji whispered these four characters. In his mind, Elder Zhou's mournful laughter as he was escorted away echoed again—'The Heavenly Eye's chess game, an ant like you doesn't understand at all!' Suddenly, understanding struck him, and he gave a tragic smile. 'So, I thought I was using the Tianji Record to peer into Heavenly Secrets, yet from the beginning, I was merely a piece placed on the chessboard by the Tianji Record.' He turned his back to Chen Nian, voice unexpectedly calm: 'That death prophecy is the Heavenly Eye's verdict against me, isn't it?'

Chen Nian nodded gently, tears glistening in her eyes. 'The death prophecy's countdown directly correlates with the frequency and depth of your Tianji Record usage. Each glimpse of the future brings that point closer.' She stepped forward, clasping Chen Ji's hands, blood-colored light flowing from her fingertips into his palm: 'But without using it... you die now.' She raised her tear-stained face: 'Brother, I refuse to lose you again. Even if only a year, a month, a day... I want you alive.'

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his sister's tears, and for the first time, cracks appeared in those always-calculating eyes. He remembered the boy who stood before her in the old Chen family mansion when she was bullied; remembered the day the Holy Sect took her away when he chased desperately through the crowd only to watch her silhouette vanish into the distance; remembered all those years living as atrash while secretly maneuvering through the world, all for this very moment to retrieve her. And now, she stood before him, holding his hand, telling him she could extend his life—yet at the cost of accelerating his death.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's words left Chen Ji momentarily suspended in silence. In three hours, his Heavenly Fate would completely deplete; yet activating the Heavenly Fate Lock Key's power would accelerate the death prophecy's countdown once again. Mo Xiansheng had once warned that the Heavenly Eye was an existence transcending all, and no one could bear the cost of provoking it. Yet Chen Nian stood before him, eyes brimming with tears as she gazed at him... How would he choose?

choices.text: Activate the Heavenly Fate Lock Key
choices.description: Have Chen Nian activate the Heavenly Fate Lock Key's power to forcibly extend life. Even if this accelerates the arrival of the death prophecy, one must survive to reshape destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate consumption, Heavenly Fate -20, death prophecy countdown accelerated
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a new method for prolonging life, temporarily escape the death deadline
choices.risk_hint: Upon activation, one may be察觉ed by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji clasped Chen Nian's hand in return, his voice low and resolute: 'Activate it, Nian'er.' He gazed at his sister's surprised eyes, a faint smile curving his lips, 'I, Chen Ji, have been maneuvering through the world for years—not to live longer, but to one day personally overturn this chessboard. Death? I am not afraid. What I fear is dying a meaningless death, dying without value.'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's tears burst forth, yet her fingers tightened without hesitation. Blood-colored light spread from her fingertips into Chen Ji's palm, then wound through his meridians, bones, and organs like creeping vines. At that moment, Chen Ji sensed an unprecedented force detonating within him—not the golden light of the Tianji Record, but something far more ancient and primal: the power of bloodline. Yet simultaneously, in the depths of his pupils, delicate blood patterns emerged, weaving together with the Tianji Record's golden radiance.

choices.description: Do not activate the Heavenly Fate Lock Key yet; search for a method that can prolong life without accelerating the death prophecy. Perhaps Mo Xiansheng still has unspoken secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Time consumed, Heavenly Fate continues to deplete
choices.visible_reward: May discover a new path for prolonging life
choices.risk_hint: Time is tight, may not be来得及

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately; instead, he closed his eyes. His consciousness descended into the Tianji Record fragment, attempting to seek Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. After a moment, a faint glow figure emerged in the depths of his consciousness—the outline of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, more translucent than ever before. 'Chen Ji... you've arrived.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a thread of exhaustion, 'I know what you are seeking.'

dialogue.content: "The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key can indeed prolong life, but activation is not the only path." Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul spoke slowly, "You and Chen Nian are twin Lock Keys—if you can find the third Lock Key in heaven and earth, you can form the 'Three Powers Locking Heaven Formation,' which will not accelerate the death prophecy, but temporarily seal it instead." Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes: "Where is the third Lock Key?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, "In the deepest part of the Ancient Forbidden Land... there, is where the Heavenly Eye first gazed upon the world."

choices.description: "Not using Chen Nian's power, but forcibly activating the hidden function of the Tianji Record using his own Heavenly Fate Value. The cost is directly consuming his life origin."
choices.visible_cost: "Massive loss of life force, permanent decrease in combat power"
choices.visible_reward: "The Tianji Record may develop new functions"

text.content: "Chen Ji lightly drew back his hand, taking a step back. Chen Nian looked at him in surprise, watching as he retrieved an ancient jade slip from his chest—the physical vessel of the first page of the Tianji Record, its inscriptions worn but still faintly glowing. 'Nian'er, no need.' He pressed the jade slip against his brow center, his voice terrifyingly calm, 'Since the Tianji Record has recognized me as its master, it should have more than just this bit of ability.'"

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji!' Chen Nian cried out, wanting to stop him but already too late. The inscriptions on the jade slip blazed brilliantly, a golden pillar of light descending from the heavens to envelop Chen Ji entirely. At the same moment, a thin line of blood cracked open at his brow center, trickling down his nose. Yet he made no sound, simply gritting his teeth as the golden light resonated with the fragment of the Tianji Record within him. After a moment, he opened his eyes—his pupils filled with intertwined golden and blood-red patterns, a completely unprecedented strange marking. 'It worked...' he murmured, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth, 'Tianji Record: Life Extension Chapter.'"

text.content: "The moment Chen Ji made his choice, an inexplicable tremor rose from his heart's depths. What he didn't know was that in a certain dimension high above the Nine Heavens, an invisible eye slowly opened. That eye had no whites, no pupils—only a chaotic void—but it was truly gazing at him. More precisely, it was gazing at the intertwined golden and blood-colored patterns within his pupils. 'Interesting.' A voice transcending language echoed through the void, 'This chess piece... is beginning to become restless.'"

"Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his heart skipping a beat. It was an extremely subtle sensation, like someone watching your back in the dead of night—nothing visible, yet you unmistakably sense a presence. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had told him: 'The Heavenly Eye is everywhere, yet exists nowhere. It observes all, yet never leaves a trace.' He drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the unsettling feeling. Now was not the time for fear—regardless of which path he chose, he had to continue forward."

dialogue.content: "'Brother, what do you see?' Chen Nian noticed the shift in his expression and worriedly gripped his arm. Chen Ji shook his head but didn't conceal it: 'Nothing. Just... suddenly feeling something watching us.' He spoke casually, yet his clenched fists betrayed his inner tension. Chen Nian was silent for a moment, then pressed her forehead against his shoulder: 'Whatever it is, I'll stay with you. Even if the Heavenly Eye truly watches... we have nothing to fear.' Her voice was soft, yet remarkably firm, 'Because we're Lock Keys—the purpose of Lock Keys is to lock away things that shouldn't exist, isn't it?'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Nian's words made Chen Ji fall into contemplation. She was right—the purpose of Lock Keys is to seal, not to be sealed. But the question was, what were they meant to seal away? Chen Ji needed to make a choice."

choices.description: "Since we're already being watched, why not proactively reveal ourselves, drawing the Heavenly Eye's attention to buy time for other arrangements."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely exposed under the Heavenly Eye's gaze"
choices.visible_reward: "May trigger a chain reaction, shifting other targets' attention"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile was faint, yet carried a resolute determination to break all bridges. 'Nian'er is right. The purpose of Lock Keys isn't to passively take hits.' He raised his head, his gaze penetrating the roof of the Council Hall, staring directly at that invisible void, 'Since the Heavenly Eye is watching, then I'll let it watch its fill.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it was like a blade, piercing straight into that emptiness. 'You want to see me as a chess piece? Then watch carefully how this chess piece topples your entire game!'"

choices.description: "Exposing ourselves now is too early; we need more leverage. Hide our strength first, secretly accumulate power, wait for the right moment."
choices.visible_reward: "Keep our trump cards, avoid being targeted"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the urge within him. He looked at Chen Nian, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. 'Nian'er, now isn't the time.' His voice regained its composure, yet carried a hint of bitterness, 'The Heavenly Eye's gaze means I've already entered its chess game. Revealing myself now would only mean dying for nothing.' He turned around, his back to that void, 'What I need to do isn't to confront the chess player—it's to overturn the board before it even realizes what's happening.'"

choices.description: Neither resisting nor enduring, but attempting to find loopholes in the Heavenly Eye's operating rules, using rules to destroy rules.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his divine consciousness sinking once more into the Tianji Record Fragment. This time, he no longer attempted to use the foresight ability, but carefully observed the scattered runes. He discovered an interesting phenomenon—the rune structure of the Tianji Record was not flawless; it concealed numerous 'breakpoints' and 'misalignments.' These breakpoints appeared to be manifestations of incompleteness, but if viewed from another angle... 'Mo Xiansheng.' He suddenly spoke, 'The Tianji Record was originally complete, wasn't it?'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long time before slowly speaking: 'Yes. The complete Tianji Record consisted of ninety-nine pages.' Chen Ji's heart trembled: 'Then the current fragments...' 'Only twelve pages remain.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of vicissitudes, 'The other eighty-seven pages were divided into countless fragments, scattered across heaven and earth. Each fragment contains a small portion of the original power of the Tianji Record.' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open: 'If I collect all the fragments...' 'You will be able to reconstruct the complete Tianji Record.' Mo Xiansheng interrupted him, 'By then, the Heavenly Eye's control over you... will be completely shattered.'

text.content: Collecting eighty-seven fragments—this thought swirled in Chen Ji's mind. He suddenly realized that although his previous layout was grand, it had never touched the core of the Tianji Record itself. Now, thinking back, those opportunities scattered across various places, those seemingly random encounters, those meticulously designed chess games... from beginning to end, he had only been using the superficial functions of the Tianji Record Fragment. The true power was sealed within those eighty-seven fragments. 'Nian.' He suddenly spoke, 'Do you know the whereabouts of the other key fragments?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian was slightly stunned, then fell into deep thought. After a moment, an unusual glint flashed in her eyes: 'During those years at the Holy Sect... they used my blood for some experiments.' Her voice trembled slightly, clearly reluctant to recall those past events, 'Once, I saw a large collection of ancient books in a secret chamber. One of them recorded the legend of 'Heavenly Secrets Fragments'—it is said that during ancient times, ninety-nine strands of heavenly secrets descended upon the world, each containing the power to rewrite fate.' She raised her head, looking at Chen Ji, 'If that legend is true... those fragments should be scattered across the Three Great Sects, the Ancient Forbidden Land, and... the depths of the Demonic Path Holy Sect.'

text.content: The Three Great Sects, the Ancient Forbidden Land, the Demonic Path Holy Sect. Chen Ji silently recited these three place names in his heart, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips. Any one of these places was a dragon's den and tiger's lair, but how could one obtain tiger cubs without entering the tiger's lair? He suddenly thought of a person—Ye Qing. That saintess of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, seemingly an enemy on the surface, but actually turned into an ally through Chen Ji's use of foresight images from the Tianji Record. If he could leverage her power... 'Nian, stay at the Tianqing Sect for now.' He spoke, his tone permitting no argument, 'I need to make a trip to the Demonic Path Holy Sect.'

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Holy Sect is Ye Qing's territory, and also the place where the Heavenly Eye's influence is weakest. However, it is still extremely dangerous there. Chen Ji needs to consider how to get there. Should he enter directly as Chen Ji, or use another identity?

choices.description: Contact Ye Qing through special channels and have her send people to provide support, safely entering the Demonic Path Holy Sect.
choices.visible_reward: Safely enter the Demonic Path Holy Sect and gain Ye Qing's intelligence support
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have her own agenda

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out a pitch-black Jade Pendant—it was the communication token Ye Qing had left him. He injected spiritual energy into it, and a faint purple light appeared on the pendant's surface. After a moment, a familiar voice rang in his mind: 'Chen Ji? I heard about the Old Dog Zhou, well done.' Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of teasing, 'Tell me, what do you need this time?' Chen Ji did not engage in pleasantries, and directly said: 'I need to enter the depths of the Holy Sect to find clues about the Heavenly Secrets Fragment.' The other side was silent for a moment, then a soft laugh came through: 'I knew it. You would eventually come to me.'

choices.description: Sneak into the Demonic Path Holy Sect alone without alerting anyone. Greater risk, but no favors owed.

text.content: Chen Ji put the Jade Pendant back into his chest, then turned to look at Chen Nian: 'No need to alert Ye Qing. I have my own way in.' As he spoke, he took out a mask as thin as a cicada's wing from his sleeve—that was a disguise treasure he had obtained during one of his opportunities, capable of perfectly changing one's identity. He pressed the mask against his face, his bones slightly shifting, features gradually changing, transforming in an instant from a timid servant into a cold-faced middle-aged man. 'Remember, if I don't send word in three days...' His voice emerged from beneath the mask, calm yet carrying an indisputable authority, 'Go find Su Qingyao.'

choices.description: Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Key; her bloodline can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Bringing her along can better conceal their whereabouts.
choices.visible_reward: Dual concealment makes it difficult to foresee.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's safety is the greatest hidden danger.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian heard his words, a flash of joy flickering in her eyes, only to be replaced by worry: "But brother, I..." Chen Ji raised his hand to interrupt her: "You are the Heavenly Fate Lock Key." His gaze was profound. "Your bloodline can interfere with the foresight of the Tianji Record—which means it can also interfere with the perception of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Taking you with me, my actions in this world will be more covert." He paused, his tone softening. "Moreover... I don't want to be separated from you again." Chen Nian's tears flowed again, but with a smile. She nodded vigorously: "Alright. Wherever brother goes, I will follow."

text.content: After making his decision, Chen Ji began his preparations. He extracted several segments about the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path from the Tianji Record Fragment—those were scenes inadvertently captured in past foresight attempts. Though blurred, they were enough to outline the general layout of the Holy Sect. At the same time, his divine consciousness began to operate, deducing every possible scenario in his mind. This was a habit he had developed over many years—no matter what opponent he faced, he would incorporate all variables into his calculations. Strategic planning before action—this was the true reason Chen Ji had survived in the gaps between powers.

Three days later. Deep night. A black shadow glided out from the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, vanishing instantly into the vast darkness. Chen Ji had changed into the stern visage behind his disguise, his body emanating a faint trace of demonic energy—carefully extracted from a captured member of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path before his departure, sufficient to deceive most detection formations. Chen Nian followed closely behind him, her body enveloped in a delicate crimson aura—the instinctive concealment effect of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, capable of rendering any foresight abilities ineffective. The siblings moved one after another, racing toward the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.

Just as they departed from the Tianqing Sect, the old sect master Ling Yuan, secluded deep within the Council Hall, suddenly opened his eyes. Cobwebs covered his meditation cushion, indicating numerous days of complete stillness. Yet the moment his eyes opened, the temperature in the entire Council Hall dropped three degrees. "Chen Ji..." his voice rasped like withered wood, "You've finally made your move." The words fell, and his figure gradually dissolved into nothingness, as if never existing. And in the nine heavens above, those invisible eyes focused once more—this time, they were no longer merely "watching"—they were calculating, deducing, waiting for the perfect moment to arrive.

"Ling Yuan... no, it's not just him." Chen Ji suddenly halted, his brow furrowed tightly. He gazed upward at the night sky, the stars still brilliant, yet he felt an indescribable pressure surging from every direction. That was the warning transmitted by the Tianji Record Fragment—something transcending human comprehension was fixating on him. The Heavenly Dao's Eye. It made no move, emitted no sound, but that intangible gaze itself was a form of oppression. "Brother?" Chen Nian sensed his异样, worrying clasping his hand. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fear within. A cold smile actually formed at the corner of his mouth. "It seems this chess piece is more valuable than I imagined." he murmured quietly. "Since that's the case, let them witness what waves this piece can create!" With that, he grabbed Chen Nian's hand and plunged into the night, vanishing within the darkness shrouded by those distant stars.
